description: Create a redirect. Rejects invalid regex, unknown status codes and redirect loops/chains deeper than 5. Returns the redirect.

from_url.description: Source path or URL (a regex pattern without delimiters when is_regex)

is_regex.description: Treat from_url as a regex (default false)

to_url.description: Target path or URL (required unless type is 410 or 451)

name: seo_create_redirect
